senses.sense_definition: To arrange soldiers or troops into a straight line.

examples.text: The sergeant ordered the platoon to <w>dress</w> the ranks immediately.

target_lang_translations.nl: De sergeant beval het peloton om onmiddellijk de gelederen te <w>richten</w>.

examples.text: Soldiers must learn to <w>dress</w> correctly during the parade.
